description:
Analogous to
`apps/octo_pi_coder/test/octo_pi/coder/integration_test.exs`
but drives the Interactive main loop against live Anthropic.

Gated `:integration` tag — excluded by default, opt in via
`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=... mix test --only integration`.

Flow:
- Start Interactive in a Task with skip_raw_mode/sigwinch,
  auto_start_reader: false, a write_fn that forwards to the
  test pid.
- Feed a trivial prompt: "Reply with exactly 'pong'".
- Use the test-support `feed_chunk` helper (see .11) to drive
  stdin.
- Assert the rendered output contains "pong".
- Ctrl+C to exit cleanly.

Also consider a tool-exercising variant (opt-in):
- Prompt: "Use the ls tool to list the current directory".
- Assert a ToolExecutionEnd event comes through for the ls tool.
- Gates real-world regression of the default-tools wiring.

Depends on .11 (Terminal.feed_chunk scoping) to use the test
helper cleanly.
title: Live-Anthropic integration test for Interactive mode
